mr_description:
- Anonymous: Add device limiter
- break auth if limit reached
- fix typo
- refactored const to make it clearer with expiration
- anon device limit for config

expected_issues.title: Race condition: Multiple concurrent requests could pass the device count check simultaneo…
expected_issues.description: Race condition: Multiple concurrent requests could pass the device count check simultaneously and create devices beyond the limit. Consider using a database transaction or lock.
expected_issues.source_text: Race condition: Multiple concurrent requests could pass the device count check simultaneously and create devices beyond the limit. Consider using a database transaction or lock.

expected_issues.title: Anonymous authentication now fails entirely if anonDeviceService.TagDevice returns ErrDev…
expected_issues.description: Anonymous authentication now fails entirely if anonDeviceService.TagDevice returns ErrDeviceLimitReached. Previously, device tagging was asynchronous and non-blocking. This change prevents anonymous users from authenticating when the device limit is reached.
expected_issues.source_text: Anonymous authentication now fails entirely if anonDeviceService.TagDevice returns ErrDeviceLimitReached. Previously, device tagging was asynchronous and non-blocking. This change prevents anonymous users from authenticating when the device limit is reached.

expected_issues.title: The updateDevice function returns ErrDeviceLimitReached when rowsAffected == 0, but zero…
expected_issues.description: The updateDevice function returns ErrDeviceLimitReached when rowsAffected == 0, but zero affected rows means the device doesn't exist or falls outside the time window, not that a limit was reached.
expected_issues.source_text: The updateDevice function returns ErrDeviceLimitReached when rowsAffected == 0, but zero affected rows means the device doesn't exist or falls outside the time window, not that a limit was reached.

expected_issues.title: Time window calculation inconsistency: Using device.UpdatedAt.UTC().Add(-anonymousDeviceE…
expected_issues.description: Time window calculation inconsistency: Using device.UpdatedAt.UTC().Add(-anonymousDeviceExpiration) as the lower bound but device.UpdatedAt as the current time may not match the intended logic. Consider using time.Now().UTC() consistently.
expected_issues.source_text: Time window calculation inconsistency: Using device.UpdatedAt.UTC().Add(-anonymousDeviceExpiration) as the lower bound but device.UpdatedAt as the current time may not match the intended logic. Consider using time.Now().UTC() consistently.

expected_issues.title: The `tagDeviceUI` function populates the local cache with the device ID before the `Creat…
expected_issues.description: The `tagDeviceUI` function populates the local cache with the device ID before the `CreateOrUpdateDevice` call. If `ErrDeviceLimitReached` is returned, the cache entry remains set, allowing subsequent requests to bypass the device limit until the cache expires after 29 minutes.
expected_issues.source_text: The `tagDeviceUI` function populates the local cache with the device ID before the `CreateOrUpdateDevice` call. If `ErrDeviceLimitReached` is returned, the cache entry remains set, allowing subsequent requests to bypass the device limit until the cache expires after 29 minutes.
